name: openreading-local-proof
description: Read local document evidence with physical page citations.
long_description: Choose an explicit document directory. OpenReading retains local source copies and extracted evidence until you remove its store. Returned excerpts enter Claude's context and may reach its cloud model. This preview uses local PyMuPDF for one PDF at a time, up to 25 MiB and 100 pages. No OCR, passwords, hosted fallback, or measured token-savings claim.

input_root.title: Document directory
input_root.description: Grant access to this directory. Sources are retained locally; retrieved excerpts enter Claude's context.

tools.name: openreading_import
tools.description: Retain one local document without returning its text.

tools.name: openreading_read
tools.description: Read exact passages with page citations.
